_comment: Defect declarations for the charge replay clip (demos/charge_demo.json); see demos/README.md, Sidecar declarations.

overlap.reason: On the deeper field the cavalry reach contact only at the end of the clip (about tick 1499), and the sampled ticks now land in that press: CI website demo-diff on PR #1677 (2-tick samples) measured uid 5 at 2.243 wu against its 2.25 wu floor and uid 8 at 4.851 wu against its 5 wu floor, merge-base 8.99 and 13.31. Both sit within 0.15 wu of their floors at contact: press-adjacent compression, not standing interpenetration. Uid 3, overlap: Dense 2-tick FULL dumps, every exemption removed, Windows, seeds 0 to 4, against 5.0: 9f9bddee reads pass on every seed; e57be4c6 (#1880) reads pass, pass, 3.51, pass, pass. Traced on seed 2 on e57be4c6: the 80-horse squadron is out of contact and gathering pace on its ATTACK (79 wu/s at tick 1352), and rider 32, 31.7 wu off his slot and closing on it, passes 3.51 wu from rider 33, 8.2 wu off his: a man walking back from far off passes through one nearer his slot (#1894). Nothing keeps them apart there: the squadron is MOVING, outside any re-slot's settle window, and from tick 1342 no rider stands more than one file pitch off his slot (the farthest, rider 32, is 38.8 wu off at tick 1342 and 31.7 at tick 1352, and the trace counts one rider beyond a pitch at 40.2 wu, tick 1340, and none after), so the same-unit standoff pass is skipped altogether. The one-pitch gate leaves a straggler about 32 wu off his slot, walking back through his file, unpoliced. Rerun on seed 0 with body_accel scaled by 1 + k * 1e-6 (k = 1 to 16, a nudge that favours no mechanism) to tell a defect from chance: uid 3 fails overlap on 0 of 16 runs on e57be4c6 and 1 of 16 on eb8b0995 (4.28), and shape_residual on 0 of 16 on both. Seed figures and reruns measured 2026-10-31; traced 2026-11-01.

shape_residual.reason: Uid 3, shape_residual: Dense 2-tick FULL dumps, every exemption removed, Windows, seeds 0 to 4, against 30.0: 9f9bddee reads pass on every seed; e57be4c6 (#1880) reads pass, pass, pass, pass, 31.25. Traced on seed 4 on e57be4c6 and on eb8b0995: late in the clip the 80-horse squadron charges on its ATTACK, out of contact, at up to 170 wu/s, with its riders strung out far behind their slots (median 520 wu off, farthest 999 at tick 1500), and its fitted residual climbs through the charge, reading 31.25 at tick 1500; eb8b0995's same seed runs the same kind of charge (median 535 wu off at tick 1454), and its worst judged sample is 19.59 at tick 1454; it reaches contact at tick 1458 and is not judged from then on, while its residual climbs on to 35.72 at tick 1500. The cavalry block drifting out of its grid while it manoeuvres is #1716's case. Rerun on seed 0 with body_accel scaled by 1 + k * 1e-6 (k = 1 to 16, a nudge that favours no mechanism) to tell a defect from chance: uid 3 fails overlap on 0 of 16 runs on e57be4c6 and 1 of 16 on eb8b0995 (4.28), and shape_residual on 0 of 16 on both. Seed figures and reruns measured 2026-10-31; traced 2026-11-01.
